methods.name: SA-MFNet
methods.summary: SA-MFNet is a semantic segmentation network for landslide detection that uses multisource data fusion. It employs an improved ResNet50-SA backbone with attention and grouping mechanisms for optical imagery, and a parallel ResNet34 branch for other topic data, fusing features through a multistage decision module.
